Hi Sophie / Medverity team — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed procurement timeline so we can align on owners and dates. Attaching a draft MAP for your review (mutual-action-plan-draft.pdf).

Key items we covered:
- Scope: Redwood inference for document ingestion + hosted inference endpoints (token-based usage).
- Primary integration owners: Sophie (Product) and Procurement Team (procurement@medverity.com).
- Billing options discussed: PO (standard enterprise path), corporate card (one-off), or cloud marketplace (marketplace listing may change billing cadence).

Proposed procurement milestone timeline (ballpark):
- Legal review (review contract + SOW): 10 business days
- Security review (questionnaire + evidence): 5 business days after we receive the questionnaire
- Finance (PO creation & approvals): 3–5 business days after legal sign-off
- Target PO issuance: ~2–3 weeks from start if PO path chosen; marketplace can add extra lead time depending on reseller onboarding.

Proposed next steps:
1) Sophie / procurement: confirm who will own the security questionnaire and preferred payment instrument (PO vs card vs marketplace).
2) Tessa/Ben: set up a 30-min procurement sync to walk the MAP and review evidence items (I can do Wed 4/13 10:30–11:00 PT).
3) Medverity: share any internal procurement templates or required contract clauses.

If we lock to PO path, I’ll update MAP with milestone owners and dates and share a version for signature.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing.

Best,
